facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: kinetic release during a statutory inspection on HO-9402

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control LIFTING_GEAR_INSPECTION: the inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control LIFT_STUDY_APPROVAL: the preparation and approval of a lift study was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear on HO-9402 and M-9402 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the preparation and approval of a lift study on HO-9402 and M-9402 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining lifting appliances, specifically supporting a load for maintenance access. HO-9402 (workshop hoists and press) is in service for heavy vehicle component removal and pressing. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear had degraded below its design intent. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 13 September 2019 an incident occurred on HO-9402 and M-9402 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during a statutory inspection, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
